units.statement: theorem C0_coordPrec_trichotomy (c c' : Coord) : CoordPrec c c' ∨ c = c' ∨ CoordPrec c' c
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the global order ≺
units.sketch: ≺ (level asc, index desc) is a strict linear order on ℕ×ℕ; trichotomy by Nat trichotomy on levels then indices. Pure omega/rcases.

units.statement: theorem C0_coordPrec_trans (a b c : Coord) (h1 : CoordPrec a b) (h2 : CoordPrec b c) : CoordPrec a c
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the global order ≺
units.sketch: Transitivity of the lex order (level asc, index desc). Pure omega/case split.

units.statement: theorem C0_coordSort (n N : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ f : Fin (n * N) → Coord, (∀ j, (f j).1 < N ∧ (f j).2 < n) ∧ ∀ j j' : Fin (n * N), j < j' ↔ CoordPrec (f j) (f j')
units.moves_ref: §C.0 'solve in ≺-order': the ≺-SORTED enumeration of the n×N box
units.sketch: Explicit enumeration f j := (j / n, n − 1 − j % n): level-major, index-descending within a level — exactly ≺. Order property by j = (j/n)·n + j%n arithmetic (omega). Witnesses JetSetup.coordOf's consistency.

units.statement: theorem C0_digitSystemMass {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) : D.mass = p ^ (m - D.numPinned)
units.moves_ref: §C.0 BLOCK CONVENTION; D.3(e)(ii)/D.11 count law
units.sketch: Specialization of the accepted L2_P6ii DigitSystem count |α|^{n−k} to α = ZMod p (Nat.card (ZMod p) = p for p prime). Reuses LeanUrat.Moves.L2_P6ii verbatim.

units.statement: theorem C0_solvedGraph {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) : ∃ E : {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution x} ≃ ({j : Fin m // D.pinned j = false} → ZMod p), ∀ (x : {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution x}) (j : {j : Fin m // D.pinned j = false}), E x j = x.1 j.1
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5' 'solve Σ_i's system in ≺-order (graph over free coordinates)'
units.sketch: The restriction-to-free-coordinates map is an equiv: injective (pinned coords are solve of earlier, strong induction) and surjective (extend by well-founded recursion — the `extend` device of L2_P6ii_R3). The extra clause pins E to BE the restriction map.

units.statement: theorem C0_pinWelldef {m : ℕ} (D D' : Locus p m) (h : ∀ x, D.IsSolution x ↔ D'.IsSolution x) : D.numPinned = D'.numPinned
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 PIN-WELLDEF (cardinality half)
units.sketch: Same solution set ⟹ same mass; both are p^{m−numPinned}; p ≥ 2 and numPinned ≤ m pin the exponent (Nat.pow injectivity).

units.statement: theorem C0_pinStatus {m : ℕ} (D D' : Locus p m) (h : ∀ x, D.IsSolution x ↔ D'.IsSolution x) : ∀ j : Fin m, D.pinned j = D'.pinned j
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 PIN-WELLDEF, rev-9 scope: cardinality AND per-coordinate free/determined STATUS
units.sketch: The projection of the solution set to coordinates ≤ j is the solution set of the truncated system, cardinality p^{(j+1)−#pinned≤j}; hence #pinned≤j is locus-determined for every j. Induction on j.

units.statement: theorem C0_unitriBij {m : ℕ} {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : IsUnitriangular Θ) : Function.Bijective Θ
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 (unitriangular ⟹ bijection, both directions)
units.sketch: Invert coordinate by coordinate in ≺-order: (Θx)_i = x_i + corr_i(earlier), so x_i is recovered from Θx by strong recursion on i.

units.statement: theorem C0_moveMass {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : Function.Bijective Θ) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution (Θ x)} = D.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.2 move maps are global digit-level bijections (Fact A/B): mass preserved
units.sketch: Equiv.ofBijective Θ restricts to {x // D.IsSol (Θx)} ≃ {y // D.IsSol y}; Nat.card_congr.

units.statement: theorem C0_pinTransport {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : IsUnitriangular Θ) : ∃ D' : Locus p m, (∀ x, D'.IsSolution x ↔ D.IsSolution (Θ x)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin m, D'.pinned j = D.pinned j
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 pin-transport corollary: Θ*(E) is a digit system with the same pins
units.sketch: Constructive: D'.pinned := D.pinned; D'.solve j f := D.solve j (Θ-image of the earlier coordinates) − corr_j(f).

units.statement: theorem C1_stripClause {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m) : ∃ cl : LevelClause p m, cl.support = {c} ∧ cl.codim = 1 ∧ ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, cl.sat x ↔ x c = 0
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) fresh STRIP clauses: literal zeros, each cuts p⁻¹; the strip branch of JetSetup.fresh_assembled
units.sketch: Construct: support {c}, codim 1, sat x := x c = 0; count: 1·p¹ = p^|{c}|. Non-vacuity witness for LevelClause and for fresh_assembled's first branch.

units.statement: theorem C1_TYP_fiberCount {m : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin m)} {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Fintype α] (T : TypObject p m S α) (v : α) : Nat.card {y : Fin m → ZMod p // T.φ y = v ∧ ∀ c ∉ S, y c = 0} * Nat.card α = p ^ S.card
units.moves_ref: §C Lemma TYP(b): additive surjection ⟹ equal kernel-coset fibers ⟹ the value clause cuts (alphabet)⁻¹
units.sketch: The supported subgroup V has card p^{|S|}; φ|V surjective (dep); fibers are kernel cosets of size |V|/|α|. The TypObject INSTANCE for a real fresh digit is the deferred graded piece.

units.statement: theorem C1_TYP_toClause {m : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin m)} {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Fintype α] (T : TypObject p m S α) (v : α) (a : ℕ) (hcard : Nat.card α = p ^ a) : ∃ cl : LevelClause p m, cl.support = S ∧ cl.codim = a ∧ ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, cl.sat x ↔ T.φ x = v
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) fresh VALUE clauses are TYP content — the value branch of JetSetup.fresh_assembled
units.sketch: Package sat := (φ · = v) with support S, codim a; dep := T.dep; count := C1.TYP_fiberCount rewritten by hcard.

units.statement: theorem C1_clausesCount {m : ℕ} (fd : FreshData p m) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // fd.sat x} * p ^ fd.mstar = p ^ m
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) 'pairwise disjoint: the factors multiply' — the joint fresh cut on the full box
units.sketch: Induction on the clause list; split the box along the head clause's support (dep + count give the exact head factor); disjoint supports factorize. THE multi-clause engine consumed by C4.conditionalMass.

units.statement: theorem C2_DOM {lines : ℕ → Line} {i interiorEnd : ℕ} (dom : DomData lines i interiorEnd) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ interiorEnd) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ i) : (lines m).at b ≤ (lines i).at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1 Lemma DOM (interior floor domination), the displayed affine induction (1)+(2)
units.sketch: Affine: line_i(b)−line_m(b) = (line_i−line_m)(interiorEnd) + (slope_i−slope_m)·(interiorEnd−b) ≥ 0. Pure ℚ/linarith. ROUND 3: DomData for the RECORDED lines is now supplied globally by C3.lineDom.

units.statement: theorem C2_DOM_floorForm {lines : ℕ → Line} {i interiorEnd : ℕ} (dom : DomData lines i interiorEnd) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ interiorEnd) : floorOf lines i b = (lines i).at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1 DOM floor form: on the factor interior the floor F_i IS the current line
units.sketch: floorOf = sup' over m ≤ i; by C2.DOM every line_m(b) ≤ line_i(b), attained at m = i.

units.statement: theorem C2_floorH_root (H : History p F) (b : ℕ) : H.floorH 0 b = ⊥
units.moves_ref: §C.1 E_fresh(ν₀) := E(ν₀) (empty floor at the root read)
units.sketch: take 0 = [], foldr max ⊥ [] = ⊥. Definitional.

units.statement: theorem C2_floorH_succ (H : History p F) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) (b : ℕ) : H.floorH (i+1) b = max (H.floorH i b) ((H.nodes[i]'hi).staircase b)
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5 (ZC-a): F_i = pointwise max of the history's line staircases, grown one node at a time
units.sketch: take (i+1) = take i ++ [nodes[i]]; foldr max over an append. Linear-order WithBot ℚ.

units.statement: theorem C2_freshFree {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : ∀ cl ∈ (J.fresh i).clauses, ∀ c ∈ cl.support, (J.Sigma i).pinned c = false
units.moves_ref: §C.1(ii): E_fresh's realizations constrain only coordinates FREE on Σ_i (round-3: statement unchanged; the JetSetup beneath is rebuilt — audit R2 F27/55)
units.sketch: i = 0: J.init. i = i'+1: fresh_band (ROUND 4 — replaces fresh_interior/fresh_above, adding the band's upper edge) places the support at interior base indices of J.zc i''s rim threshold (prevRim (i'+1) = μ_{i'}·childWidth_{i'}) and puts its DEFINED height htH i strictly above floorH i (conjuncts 1+2 of inFreshBand); monotonicity htH (i'+1) ≥ htH i' (the extra κ-term is ≥ 0 — needs h,e ≥ 1 from coherence/Node) feeds (J.zc i').downset_exact (pinned ↔ htH (i'+1) ≤ floor) to force pinned = false. NOTE round 3: the height in zc is htH (i'+1), in fresh_band htH (i'+1 = i); the prover must bridge the one-step κ-monotonicity — flag if blocked.

units.statement: theorem C2_EInh_implied {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) (j : Fin m) (hint : (J.coordOf j).2 < (H.nodes[i]'hi).μ * (H.nodes[i]'hi).childWidth) (hbelow : ((H.htH (i+1) (J.coordOf j) : ℚ) : WithBot ℚ) ≤ H.floorH (i+1) (J.coordOf j).2) : ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, (J.Sigma (i+1)).IsSolution x → x j = 0
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i) forced zeros from the exact-downset (ZC) — round 3: re-keyed from the deleted bare J.ht to the DEFINED H.htH (audit R2 F26/47); the full C.1(i) implication is now the separate sentence J.inh_implied
units.sketch: (J.zc i).downset_exact ← direction gives pinned j; interior_zero gives solve j ≡ 0; IsSolution evaluates x j = 0.

units.statement: theorem C3_crossing {old new : Line} (hsteep : old.slope < new.slope) (s0 jstar : ℕ) (hend0 : old.at s0 ≤ new.at s0) (hend1 : old.at jstar ≤ new.at jstar) (b : ℕ) (hb0 : s0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ jstar) : old.at b ≤ new.at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i)(α) THE ENDPOINT/AFFINE-LINE COMPARISON (rev 10)
units.sketch: new−old is affine in b, ≥ 0 at both endpoints ⟹ ≥ 0 on [s0, jstar]. Pure ℚ/nlinarith.

units.statement: theorem C3_crossing_reverse {old new : Line} (hsteep : old.slope < new.slope) (jstar : ℕ) (hend : new.at jstar ≤ old.at jstar) (b : ℕ) (hb : jstar ≤ b) : new.at b ≤ old.at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i)(γ) right of the crossing slot j×
units.sketch: new−old strictly decreases in b; ≤ 0 at jstar ⟹ ≤ 0 beyond. Pure ℚ/nlinarith.

units.statement: theorem C3_vtxPolyNe {K : Type*} [Field K] (ψ Ranch : Polynomial K) (μ : ℕ) (hmonic : ψ.Monic) (hdeg : 0 < ψ.natDegree) (hord : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ) : (Ranch /ₘ ψ ^ μ) %ₘ ψ ≠ 0
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the transported vertex value's polynomial factor is NONZERO (ord exact). ROUND 3 note: Node.vtx now carries m̂ = −t·h·g at the NODE's recorded read Bézout pair (F10 fixed); this unit is unchanged (bare polynomials)
units.sketch: If the mod were 0 then ψ^{μ+1} ∣ Ranch — contradicting hord.2. FLAG (honest residue gap): nonvanishing of the EVALUATION at z̄ needs the K(z̄) ≃ K[z]/ψ bridge; vtx ≠ 0 is not claimed as a unit.

units.statement: theorem C3_steeperChain (H : History p F) (hcoh : HistoryCoherent H) (i j : ℕ) (hj : j < H.nodes.length) (hij : i < j) : (H.nodes[i]'(lt_trans hij hj)).line.slope < (H.nodes[j]'hj).line.slope
units.moves_ref: §C DOM(1) (I-aug) along the whole history (statement unchanged; HistoryCoherent beneath is retyped — IsNodeLift, Bézout ties, intercept ties: audit R2 F3/F10/54/56/59)
units.sketch: Induction on j: the consecutive-steeper clause of HistoryCoherent chains transitively (clause position shifted by the round-3 additions; content identical).

units.statement: theorem C3_widthConfine (ν : Node p F) : ν.μ * ν.childWidth ≤ ν.wSide * ν.Dwidth
units.moves_ref: §C DOM(3)/C.1.0(b)(ii) (W): the factor interior lies inside the read side's span — μ·e·g ≤ wSide from the recorded node data alone
units.sketch: childWidth = e·g·Dwidth, so the claim is μ·e·g ≤ wSide. Ranch ≠ 0 (hpat0: coeff 0 ≠ 0); natDegree Ranch = wSide/e (hRanch + hpatTop); ψ^μ ∣ Ranch (hOrd.1) with ψ monic of degree g gives μ·g ≤ wSide/e (Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd); multiply by e and use hEdvd ((wSide/e)·e = wSide).

units.statement: theorem C3_lineDom (H : History p F) (hcoh : HistoryCoherent H) (hreal : Realizable H) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) (j : ℕ) (hij : j ≤ i) (b : ℕ) (hb : b < (H.nodes[i]'hi).μ * (H.nodes[i]'hi).childWidth) : (H.nodes[j]'(by omega)).line.at b ≤ (H.nodes[i]'hi).line.at b
units.moves_ref: §C Lemma DOM for the RECORDED lines — ROUND 4 (audit R3 finding 16): rev 14's DOM quantifies over REALIZABLE prefixes and sources the span-entry inequality from (SAE); the statement now HYPOTHESIZES the realizability class (the round-3 weak coherence ties are deleted)
units.sketch: Induction on i. Step i−1 → i: b < μ_i·cW_i ≤ wSide_i·D_i (C3.widthConfine) ≤ j*_i·D_i; hreal's TransitionAdmissible at step i gives new ≥ old at j*_i·D_i — the (SAE) span clause at j = j* STRICT when j* < μ_{i−1} (non-adjacent), the (SAE) vertex-equality clause when j* = μ_{i−1} (adjacent); with line_{i−1}.slope < line_i.slope (steeper, coherence) the affine comparison (new−old decreasing, ≥ 0 at j*·D) gives domination left of j*·D ⊇ [0, μ_i·cW_i). Recurse: b < μ_i·cW_i ≤ j*_i·D_i ≤ μ_{i−1}·D_i = μ_{i−1}·cW_{i−1} (window containment s0+wSide ≤ μ_{i−1} + width chain D_i = cW_{i−1}), so the IH applies at i−1. Base j = i trivial.

units.statement: theorem C4_conditionalMass {m : ℕ} (Sigma : Locus p m) (fd : FreshData p m) (hfree : ∀ cl ∈ fd.clauses, ∀ c ∈ cl.support, Sigma.pinned c = false) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // Sigma.IsSolution x ∧ fd.sat x} * p ^ fd.mstar = Sigma.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1): mass(Σ ∩ fresh) = mass(Σ)·p^{−m*} — THE per-step conditional exactness, address-free
units.sketch: C0.solvedGraph turns Σ-solutions into free-coordinate assignments; clauses live inside the free coordinates (hfree); C1.clausesCount transported along free ↪ Fin m gives the exact joint factor.

units.statement: theorem C4_stepMass {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma (i+1)).mass * p ^ (J.fresh i).mstar = (J.Sigma i).mass
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1)+(2) mass clause (statement unchanged; ROUND 3: the recursion runs through the STRATUM — J.recursion + J.inh_implied replace the round-2 fresh-only recursion, audit R2 F43)
units.sketch: J.recursion: Σ_{i+1} sols = Θ_i-pullback of {Σ_i ∧ stratum i}; J.inh_implied rewrites stratum i to (fresh i).sat ON Σ_i-solutions (the conjunction lives there); Θ_i bijective (C0.unitriBij on J.Theta_uni) + C0.moveMass transport; C4.conditionalMass with hfree := C2.freshFree.

units.statement: theorem C4_numPinnedStep {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma (i+1)).numPinned = (J.Sigma i).numPinned + (J.fresh i).mstar
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5' (ZC-c) codimension bookkeeping via PIN-WELLDEF (statement unchanged; JetSetup retyped)
units.sketch: Write both masses as p-powers (C0.digitSystemMass), combine with C4.stepMass; Nat.pow injectivity (p ≥ 2, numPinned ≤ m).

units.statement: theorem C5_massRec {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma k).numPinned = (Finset.range k).sum (fun i => (J.fresh i).mstar)
units.moves_ref: §C.2 proof spine: the (ZC-c) mass recursion (statement unchanged; ROUND 3: the summands are now PINNED to the D.11 inventory by J.mstar_eq — audit R2 F39/blocker 57)
units.sketch: Induction on k: base — J.init gives numPinned (Sigma 0) = 0; step — C4.numPinnedStep.

units.statement: theorem C5_massCodim {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma k).mass = p ^ (m - (Finset.range k).sum (fun i => (J.fresh i).mstar))
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5 (ZC-c): mass(Σ_{k−1}) = p^{nN}·∏ vol_nom(E_fresh), division-free (statement unchanged; JetSetup retyped)
units.sketch: Rewrite C0.digitSystemMass by C5.massRec.

units.statement: theorem C6_transportedAdmissible {m : ℕ} (Sigma Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ Sigma Z) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // Sigma.IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x} * p ^ Z.numPinned = Sigma.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.2 admissible Z cuts exactly vol(Z) on the final state
units.sketch: Join system: pinned := Sigma.pinned ∨ Z.pinned (disjoint by hZ), solve accordingly; numPinned adds; C0.digitSystemMass both sides.

units.statement: theorem C6_psiBij {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (J.Psi k)

units.statement: theorem C6_transportedSystem {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) (x : Fin m → ZMod p) : (J.Sigma k).IsSolution x ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k), (J.fresh i).sat (J.seg i k x)

units.statement: theorem C6_thmC_a {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ (J.Sigma H.nodes.length) Z) : Function.Bijective (J.Psi H.nodes.length) ∧ J.SHZ Z = (J.Psi H.nodes.length) '' {x : Fin m → ZMod p | (J.Sigma H.nodes.length).IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x} ∧ Nat.card (J.SHZ Z) = Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // (J.Sigma H.nodes.length).IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x}
units.moves_ref: §C.2 THEOREM C(a), ROUND 3 (audit R2 F35/45/blocker 58): S(H,Z) := JetSetup.SHZ is INDEPENDENTLY defined (the transported system T(H,Z) as the ∃-chain over the recorded moves — no image, no Sigma); the theorem PROVES (i) Ψ_H bijective, (ii) the classifier locus EQUALS the Ψ_H-image of the final joint locus Σ_k ∩ locus(Z), (iii) equal mass
units.sketch: (i) C6.psiBij. (ii) ⊇: given a final-locus point x, the chain y i := seg i len x witnesses SHZ (fresh-sat by C6.transportedSystem, terminal Z directly); ⊆: a chain y for x₀ satisfies y 0 = Psi len (y len) (chain equations fold to the seg composite); y len solves Σ_len by C6.transportedSystem (the chain supplies exactly the transported fresh predicates) and Z; so x₀ is in the image. (iii) image count under the injective Psi = source count (Nat.card_congr on the image factorization) + (ii).

units.statement: theorem C6_thmC_b {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ (J.Sigma H.nodes.length) Z) : Nat.card (J.SHZ Z) * p ^ totalPins J Z = boxMass p m
